title: Mindful Making: Raku Prep Session
source_quote: MINDFUL MAKING: RAKU PREP SESSION SunDay March 22 4PM to 7PM Cost: $95
evidence_sentence: The prep session is where potters create pieces using heat-shock-resistant clay for raku firing.
evidence_quote: In the raku prep session, you'll create your own pieces using clay specially designed to resist heat shock, which helps them survive the dramatic temperature changes of raku firing.
summary: Prepare bisque-fired pieces for raku firing by making your own in this three-hour session; no prior experience needed. Cost $95; studio bisque pieces available for purchase if you don't have work ready.
